rationale: The blind translation is equivalent to the mathematical content of Remark 2.7.14. It explicitly unfolds psi2 finiteness using the pinned definition, represents L-infinity membership by an almost-everywhere finite bound, and represents finite Lp membership by integrability of |X|^p for every real p>=1. The source's reversed ordering of the two supporting citations does not alter the displayed hierarchy.
